mapper.select: SELECT AD03_COMPANY AS COMPANY, AD03_ID AS USERID, AD03_NAME AS USER_NAME, AD03_PASSWORD AS PASSWORD, AD03_ROLE AS ROLE, AD01_NAME AS COMPANY_NAME, AD01_USE_TYPE AS COMPANYUSETYPE, AD03_EMPNO AS EMP_NO, CM02_NAME AS EMP_NAME, AD01_LOCK AS COMPANY_LOCK, AD03_FACTORY AS FACTORY, AD02_NAME AS FACTORY_NAME FROM TB_AD_03 LEFT JOIN TB_AD_01 ON AD03_COMPANY = AD01_COMPANY LEFT JOIN TB_CM_02 ON AD03_EMPNO = CM02_EMPNO AND AD03_COMPANY = CM02_COMPANY LEFT JOIN TB_AD_02 ON AD03_FACTORY = AD02_FACTORY AND AD02_COMPANY = AD03_COMPANY WHERE 1 = 1 AND AD03_COMPANY = #{company} AND AD03_FACTORY = #{factory} AND AD03_ID = #{userId}
